displayName: OCI-AI-DB-035: AI — LLM Agent Tool Use Abuse
description:
Detects abuse of LLM agent tool/function calling capabilities for unauthorized actions

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — llm agent tool use abuse

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_035", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%llm%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%agent%') AND "value" > 0
